name: camayoc_wf_plane_promotion_record
description: workflow-and-archive Q13, the move-rule half: when a fact was promoted out of crew:inferred, what the promotion recorded — which plane it left, which it entered, and whether the source interval was actually closed. camayoc:sourceLeftOpen is the load-bearing cell: false means scripts/promote_plane.py closed the source episode (a bitemporal interval close, never a delete), true means it could not name the source episode and said so rather than implying a close that never happened. GRAPH ?plane rather than a FROM parameter because the record lands in the TARGET plane and a caller asking whether a promotion happened does not yet know which that was. The second half of Q13 — is the original still visible as-of its write time — is quipu's bitemporal replay and not expressible here; the close being bitemporal is what makes the answer yes.
template: PREFIX camayoc: <https://camayoc.local/ontology/> SELECT ?plane ?record ?promotedFrom ?promotedInto ?sourceLeftOpen WHERE { GRAPH ?plane { <{fact}> camayoc:planePromotion ?record . ?record camayoc:promotedFrom ?promotedFrom ; camayoc:promotedInto ?promotedInto ; camayoc:sourceLeftOpen ?sourceLeftOpen } }

params.name: fact
params.description: fact parameter for this stored query.
